position232.finding: Local Federation.netplay_answer returns the static detail template. netplay_invite creates answer using body.detail and drops detail_template. Remote-peer branch can return arbitrary body.detail; it does not currently forward peer templates, which prevents external template authority.
position232.recommendation: For peer.kind == romm and the local static missing verdict only, copy the locally authored exact allowlisted detail template into answer. Keep peer-supplied templates discarded; render unknown detail through escaped opaque fallback.

position237.finding: The origin formatter returns the app-authored label “On disk (plays now)” for internal value local; the marker resolves the locale key and language updates traverse option elements. However applyTranslatedLabel sets the option textContent to only the translation, deleting the appended “(count)” on initial library render and language change. The helper also runs exact localization lookup for unformatted genre/region/decade/source values; arbitrary values stay unchanged unless they exactly collide with a catalog source. This is a correctness risk for external metadata.
position237.recommendation: Preserve the count as a separate stored numeric suffix and reformat on label refresh. Apply translations only to explicit app-authored labels from a trusted formatter/map; render raw metadata as escaped opaque text without source lookup.
